" ) def compose_post_html( poster_name: str, headline: str, text: str, hashtags: List[str] ) -> str: """ Construct an XSS‑protected HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- poster_name : str The name of the author. headline : str The post headline. text : str The main content of the post. hashtags : List[str] A list of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str The escaped HTML string ready for rendering in a browser. """ # Escape all user‑supplied data to prevent injection safe_poster_name = html.escape(poster_name, quote=True) safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_text = html.escape(text, quote=False) # Build the tags section; each tag is wrapped in a safe_tags = "" for tag in hashtags: # Normalize the tag: strip whitespace, escape special chars cleaned_tag = html.escape(tag.strip(), quote=True) if cleaned_tag: # Skip empty tags safe_tags += f"{cleaned_tag} " # Strip trailing space from tags string safe_tags = safe_tags.rstrip() # Compose the final HTML using the template return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( poster_name=safe_poster_name, headline=safe_headline, text=safe_text, tags=safe_tags )
